title: The functional and structural characterisation of the bZIP transcription factors from Myristica fragrans Houtt. associated to plant disease-resistant defence: An insight from transcriptomics and computational modelling.
authors: Sarmah, Prasanna; Das, Bikas; Verma, Jitendra Singh; Banik, Dipanwita
one_liner_zh: 该文结合转录组学与计算建模表征肉豆蔻bZIP转录因子，并通过分子对接和MD模拟分析TGA-NPR1互作，虽涉及TF-DNA结合功能但未聚焦DNA结合位点或界面机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The bZIP transcription factors play crucial roles in various aspects of plant biology, including development, defence mechanisms, senescence, and responses to both biotic and abiotic environmental stresses. Myristica fragrans Houtt. transcriptome analysis has identified 15 bZIP transcription factors, each exhibiting major conserved domains and motifs such as BRLZ, MFMR, and DOG1. Functional characterisation of these identified MfbZIP factors indicates their predominant localisation within the nucleus. Phylogenetic analysis reveals that MfbZIP factors cluster into three subgroups alongside annotated bZIP sequences from Magnolia sinica and Arabidopsis thaliana. Moreover, gene ontology (GO) analysis highlights several key functions of MfbZIP, including involvement in defence responses, abscisic acid-induced signalling pathways, and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Further investigation through KEGG pathway analysis reveals that the amino acid sequences of MfbZIP contain binding motifs for proteins such as TGA, implicated in plant hormone signal transduction pathways associated with disease resistance. To confirm the disease-defence-related activity of the TGA binding protein within MfbZIP, we employed amino acid sequences for 3-D ab initio modelling. Subsequently, we analysed TGA-NPR1 interactions using docking and molecular dynamics simulation analysis. These analyses shed light on the functional and structural aspects of TGA, demonstrating its stable association with NPR1 protein and its significance in the expression of PR1 protein, thus playing a pivotal role in defence responses against pathogens.
abstract_zh: bZIP转录因子在植物生物学的多个方面发挥着关键作用，包括发育、防御机制、衰老以及对生物和非生物环境胁迫的响应。肉豆蔻（Myristica fragrans Houtt.）转录组分析已鉴定出15个bZIP转录因子，每个均表现出主要的保守结构域和基序，如BRLZ、MFMR和DOG1。对这些已鉴定MfbZIP因子的功能表征表明，它们主要定位于细胞核内。系统发育分析显示，MfbZIP因子与来自滇南木兰（Magnolia sinica）和拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）的已注释bZIP序列聚为三个亚组。此外，基因本体论（GO）分析突出了MfbZIP的若干关键功能，包括参与防御反应、脱落酸诱导的信号通路以及DNA结合转录因子活性。通过KEGG通路分析进一步研究表明，MfbZIP的氨基酸序列包含与TGA等蛋白的结合基序，这些蛋白参与与抗病性相关的植物激素信号转导通路。为确认MfbZIP中TGA结合蛋白的病害防御相关活性，我们采用氨基酸序列进行三维从头建模。随后，我们利用对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟分析研究了TGA-NPR1相互作用。这些分析揭示了TGA的功能和结构方面，证明其与NPR1蛋白的稳定结合及其在PR1蛋白表达中的重要性，从而在抵御病原体的防御反应中发挥关键作用。
